fundamentals.margin_analysis: Q2 operating margin 60.3% versus 49.6% a year earlier; revenue rose 36%. Net income also benefited from NT$63.20bn Vanguard disposal/mark-to-market gains, so 77.4% net growth is not wholly recurring.
fundamentals.debt_analysis: Cash/marketables NT$3,518.01bn versus interest-bearing debt NT$1,031.68bn. H1 CFO NT$1,482.341bn exceeded capex NT$846.765bn.
fundamentals.growth_outlook: Q3 revenue guidance US$44.6–45.8bn implies growth; guided operating margin 56–58% is below Q2. Both are prospective.
key_risks: One-off gains and rising inventory days
key_strengths: Large net cash and positive post-capex cash flow
fundamentals.summary: Operating growth, high margins and internally funded investment support buy. One-off investment gains and lower guided margins temper confidence.
